question: Should OpenClaw support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn/plugin-owned until a broader scheduled-job routing contract is chosen?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix shape changes public task syntax, model/provider precedence, and shared-session behavior, so automation should not choose the API boundary.

options.title: Unify scheduled routing first
options.body: Defer native HEARTBEAT.md syntax until maintainers choose a single cron/heartbeat model override contract that covers scheduled runs without one-off parser policy.

options.title: Add native task hints
options.body: Add task-level model/provider fields to HEARTBEAT.md, split or group due tasks by effective model, and prove timestamps and session model state stay correct.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks are one model-routed turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless a missing generic seam is proven.

recommendation.title: Unify scheduled routing first
recommendation.body: Defer native HEARTBEAT.md syntax until maintainers choose a single cron/heartbeat model override contract that covers scheduled runs without one-off parser policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined heartbeat history and product-boundary signal for deciding whether this public syntax belongs in core.
